panels.description: Global PAPER account drawdown; deliberately labelled account-level.

panels.title: Attribution
panels.description: 2=fully reconciled; 1=ledger is newer and canonical economics is still refreshing; 0=unverifiable or true divergence.

panels.title: Cumulative Multi-Crypto PnL

panels.title: Realized PnL by Asset

panels.title: Lane Realized PnL

panels.title: Realized Return on Turnover

panels.title: Fees / Turnover (bps)

panels.title: Open Capital at Risk by Lane
panels.description: Derived only from attributable BUY fills whose position has no canonical FINAL yet; missing identity stays N/A.

panels.title: Realized PnL by Strategy / Lane
panels.description: Canonical ledger attribution by model family / strategy.

panels.title: Coordinator Candidate Crypto Risk
panels.description: Opportunity/candidate exposure seen by the coordinator; this is not the same as capital actually open in the canonical ledger.

panels.title: Execution Counts

panels.title: Candidate Exposure by Asset

panels.title: Registered Lanes
panels.description: Expected full universe is 12 = 6 assets × 2 horizons.

panels.title: Lanes with Economic Evidence

panels.title: New-Risk Authorized Lanes
panels.description: Safety visibility only; dashboard itself has no execution authority.

panels.title: Attribution Gap
panels.description: Canonical realized PnL minus attributed ledger PnL. A temporary non-zero value is expected only when Attribution says CANONICAL REFRESH.

panels.title: Unattributed FINAL Rows
panels.description: Must be zero for clean asset×horizon attribution.

panels.title: Canonical Ledger
panels.description: Read-only accounting source validity.

panels.title: Economic Evidence Present
panels.description: 0 means N/A for performance, not zero PnL.

panels.title: New-Risk Authority
panels.description: This is observed authority state; the monitoring system cannot grant authority.

options.content: **PAPER / SHADOW monitoring only.** Multi-crypto performance is derived from canonical PAPER sources. A lane without attributable economic events is **N/A**, not `$0`. Realized PnL uses canonical economics when current; if a newer complete ledger FINAL exists, the dashboard may temporarily show the ledger value while Attribution reads **CANONICAL REFRESH**. A true fresh mismatch remains **CHECK GAP**. Equity is intentionally separated from PnL charts.
